palaces.name: Changement & Innovation
palaces.place: A start-up office in an old factory

rooms.name: The front door
rooms.scene: The old wooden door is stuck by **l'inertie**. You kick it open: **un changement de paradigme**. A spark (**un catalyseur de changement**) flies onto a sign saying **transformation numérique**.

rooms.name: The lab
rooms.scene: Engineers in white coats test **un prototype** shaped like a lightbulb. On the wall, framed **brevets d'invention**. A radio plays **la veille technologique** news all day.

rooms.name: The meeting room
rooms.scene: A whiteboard says **remise en question**. The team does yoga to show **la flexibilité des structures**, then makes a sharp turn: **le pivot stratégique**.

rooms.name: The window
rooms.scene: Through the window you see a heavy cloud (**une tendance lourde**) and an old fax machine rusting: **l'obsolescence**. A rocket marked **déploiement** launches.

rooms.name: The roof
rooms.scene: On the roof, people shout verbs: they **innovent**, **bouleversent** the furniture, **réinventent** the chairs and **déploient** a giant flag.

rooms.name: The waiting room
rooms.scene: A poster on **la santé publique** shows a smiling grandma (**l'espérance de vie**). A man asleep on a bench shows **la sédentarité**; a jogger runs past: **un mode de vie actif**.

rooms.name: The doctor's office
rooms.scene: Your **médecin traitant** writes **une ordonnance**, gives **un diagnostic** and a **vaccin**. A box of **médicaments** sits on the desk.

rooms.name: The corridor
rooms.scene: Patients cough: **une maladie contagieuse**, **une épidémie**. A sign lists **les symptômes**. One person carries a heavy backpack (**le surpoids**).

rooms.name: The cafeteria
rooms.scene: A tray with **une alimentation équilibrée**; a nutritionist points at **les carences**. A pillow on the table reminds you of **le sommeil**.

rooms.name: The exit
rooms.scene: At the door, nurses **soignent**, **guérissent** and **préviennent**. A cigarette sign says it **nuit à la santé**.

palaces.name: Travail & Emploi
palaces.place: A job fair in a big hall

rooms.name: The entrance
